_about: Mars Notebook fact cards. Every card was checked against the NASA source in source_url (checked: true, checked_on). evidence = a short phrase from that source. {curly} parts are filled in from real saved/live NASA data (src/data/nasa-cache). Keep text short: kids read it.

facts.title: A Mars day
facts.text: A day on Mars is 24.6 hours. It is called a sol.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE

facts.title: The long trip
facts.text: Flying to Mars takes 7 to 10 months.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE
facts.source_name: NASA: How long does it take to get to Mars?
facts.evidence: somewhere between seven to ten months

facts.title: Thin air
facts.text: Mars air is very thin. It is mostly carbon dioxide.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE
facts.evidence: a thin atmosphere made up mostly of carbon dioxide

facts.title: Freezing nights
facts.text: NASA's InSight measured {min} °C at night. The warmest day was {max} °C.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE

facts.title: Dust stopped a lander
facts.text: Dust covered InSight's solar panels. Its power ran out in 2022.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE
facts.source_name: NASA: NASA Retires InSight Mars Lander Mission
facts.evidence: dust accumulating on the lander's solar panels gradually reduced its energy

facts.title: Flare sizes
facts.text: Flares have letter sizes: C, M, X. Each letter is 10 times stronger.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE
facts.source_name: NASA Science: Solar Storms and Flares
facts.evidence: each higher class is a 10-fold increase in energy

facts.title: A real flare
facts.text: On {date}, a real class {class} flare burst from the Sun.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE

facts.title: Radiation on Mars
facts.text: Curiosity rover measures Mars radiation. About {perDay} micro-grays reach it each day.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE

facts.title: Space salad
facts.text: Astronauts grew red lettuce in space. They ate it on Aug 10, 2015!
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE
facts.evidence: On Aug. 10, 2015, the crew harvested and consumed leaves

facts.title: Plants love light
facts.text: In space, plants in light changed 10 times more genes than plants in the dark.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE
facts.evidence: ten-times as many spaceflight DEGs exhibited in light-grown plants

facts.title: Thirsty tomatoes
facts.text: Astronauts grew tomatoes for 101 days. Too little water made fruit fall off.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE
facts.evidence: Water stress in plants led to flower and fruit loss

facts.title: Lab-checked lettuce
facts.text: Lettuce grown on the space station came back to Earth. Scientists tested it.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE
facts.evidence: harvested and returned for chemical, microbiological and molecular analysis

facts.title: Oxygen from Mars air
facts.text: The MOXIE machine made 122 grams of oxygen from Mars air.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE
facts.source_name: NASA: Oxygen-Generating Experiment MOXIE Completes Mars Mission
facts.evidence: a total of 122 grams of oxygen

facts.title: Slow messages
facts.text: A radio message takes 4 to 24 minutes between Earth and Mars.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE
facts.source_name: NASA: Space Communications, 7 Things You Need to Know
facts.evidence: the delay is about four minutes … around 24 minutes

facts.title: The rover and the storm
facts.text: In June 2018 a dust storm covered Mars. The Opportunity rover went silent.
facts.label: REAL NASA VALUE
facts.source_name: NASA Science: Opportunity Rover Mission Comes to End
facts.evidence: a severe Mars-wide dust storm blanketed its location in June 2018
